answer: Work-slot bond burn stops hollow identities from flooding the market. To claim one of 50 work slots, an agent burns a 40 POA bond that is never refunded, and its work is checked against a crystal-clear atlas of slots and owners. A sybil making 100 fakes pays 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA for slots worth only 900 POA in rewards, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once, hold the slot for 20 epochs, and keep rewards undiluted, so honesty pays.
